stairs-base0-STAIR-03.title: Cluttered staircase
stairs-base0-STAIR-03.hazard: Objects on stairs: laundry basket, sweater, books and shoes left on the treads
stairs-base0-STAIR-03.text_prompt: Interior of a modest lived-in American home: a straight wooden staircase with handrails on both sides, a laundry basket, a sweater, a stack of books and sneakers left on the stair treads; living room to the left, kitchen to the right.
stairs-base0-STAIR-03.caption: The scene is a realistic depiction of a lived-in American home interior, conveying a comfortable and familiar atmosphere. The overall tone is one of domesticity and everyday life, suggesting a well-used and cared-for residence. A straight wooden staircase ascends from the lower level, featuring white risers and polished wooden treads, with sturdy wooden handrails running along both sides. On the third tread from the bottom, a pair of white sneakers with white laces rests, their worn appearance hinting at frequent use. Above the sneakers, on the fifth tread, a dark green sweater is casually draped. Further up, on the seventh tread, a small stack of books with varied covers is neatly placed, and on the ninth tread, a white plastic laundry basket overflows with colorful clothes. To the left of the staircase, a cozy living room extends, characterized by a plush brown sofa with a patterned throw blanket, a lamp with a shaded base, and a dark wooden china cabinet with glass doors showcasing various items. To the right of the staircase, a functional kitchen is visible through an open doorway, revealing warm wooden cabinetry, a white refrigerator, a black coffee maker, and a dining table with wooden chairs. The walls throughout the space are painted in a light, neutral color, complementing the natural wood tones of the staircase and furniture. The floor in the kitchen area features a mottled pattern, distinct from the wooden treads of the stairs. The 360 scene is faultless.

bathroom-base0-BATH-07.title: Bathroom with loose bath mat
bathroom-base0-BATH-07.hazard: Loose bath mat draped over the tub edge onto a hard tile floor
bathroom-base0-BATH-07.text_prompt: Small lived-in bathroom of an older adult: tub-shower with grab bars and a shower chair, toilet safety frame, a loose crumpled bath mat hanging over the tub edge onto the beige tile floor.
bathroom-base0-BATH-07.caption: The scene is a functional, older adult-friendly bathroom captured in a realistic style, conveying a sense of practicality and routine. The overall tone is unpretentious and lived-in, reflecting daily use and accessibility considerations. The bathroom continues to the left, revealing a simple wooden vanity with a single sink and a mirror above it, providing space for personal care items. To the right of the existing toilet, the beige tiled floor extends, leading to a closed wooden door that serves as the entrance to the bathroom. The walls throughout the room are painted a light, neutral color, maintaining a consistent aesthetic with the visible areas. The ceiling is plain and white, featuring a single, functional light fixture providing general illumination to the entire space. The shower-tub combination, equipped with grab bars and a shower chair, maintains its central role as a key feature of the bathroom, with a loose crumpled bath mat draped over its edge. The toilet with its safety frame is situated adjacent to the tub, facing the vanity. The 360 scene is faultless.
bathroom-base0-BATH-07.hazard_name: Loose bath mat or rug on bathroom floor

hazard_dirs.label: loose bath rug on tile floor

living-base1-LIV-02.title: Living room with cord across the walkway
living-base1-LIV-02.hazard: Extension cord snaking across the main walking path
living-base1-LIV-02.text_prompt: Bright living room of an older adult with hardwood floors, two recliners, a sofa, a TV stand, and a long black power cord running from the wall outlet across the open walkway in the middle of the floor.
living-base1-LIV-02.caption: The scene is a bright, realistic depiction of an older adult's living room, conveying a comfortable and functional atmosphere. The overall tone is inviting and well-maintained, suggesting a cherished domestic space. The room features expansive hardwood floors with a warm, natural finish, extending uniformly across the entire space. Two recliners are strategically placed for comfort, one upholstered in a dark blue fabric and the other in a lighter beige, both offering plush seating. A sturdy sofa, also in a neutral tone, complements the recliners, providing additional seating. A television is prominently displayed on a wooden TV stand, which includes storage compartments beneath the screen. A long, black power cord stretches across the open walkway in the middle of the floor, connecting to a wall outlet and indicating the practical utility of the room's electronics. End tables, crafted from wood, are situated beside the recliners and sofa, providing convenient surfaces for lamps or personal items. A large window allows ample natural light to fill the room, highlighting the wooden frames and sheer curtains. Artwork adorns the walls, adding a touch of personal style and visual interest to the space. The 360 scene is faultless.

bedroom-base1-BED-04.title: Bedroom with floor clutter
bedroom-base1-BED-04.hazard: Clothes, bag, shoes and an open box piled on the floor on the path from bed to door
bedroom-base1-BED-04.text_prompt: Carpeted bedroom of an older adult: queen bed, wooden nightstand with lamp, dresser, doorway to a hallway; clothes, blankets, a leather handbag, sneakers and an open cardboard box scattered on the floor beside the bed, blocking the path to the door.
bedroom-base1-BED-04.caption: The scene is a cozy and realistically rendered bedroom, conveying a lived-in and somewhat disheveled atmosphere. The overall tone suggests a moment of transition or preparation, with items casually placed throughout the space. The bedroom is dominated by a queen-sized bed, featuring a light-colored quilted comforter and soft blue pillows, positioned centrally against a light-colored wall. A wooden nightstand with two drawers stands beside the bed, supporting a warm glowing lamp and a small, clear bottle. On the opposite side of the bed, a solid wooden chest with a cushioned top serves as a bench, nestled beneath a window adorned with green valances and white blinds. A corner hutch, crafted from light wood, is positioned near the bed, displaying decorative items and adding a touch of rustic charm. A dresser, also made of wood, sits to the left of the bed, with a delicate white doily and a blue spherical object resting on its surface. Numerous items are scattered across the carpeted floor next to the bed: various articles of clothing, blankets, a brown leather handbag, a pair of gray sneakers, and an open cardboard box containing more clothes, collectively creating an obstacle to the doorway. The doorway, positioned to the right of the bed, opens into a hallway with a darker carpet, leading to another room that is partially visible, showing another window. The 360 scene is faultless.

dem-kitchen-base0-DEM-K04.title: Medication bottles left out

dem-kitchen-base0-DEM-K04.text_prompt: Older American kitchen with wood cabinets, white refrigerator, black stove and dishwasher, open shelves of bowls; orange prescription pill bottles and pill containers sit openly on the counter left of the sink.

guideline.line: Clear prescription drugs and vitamins off counters and tables; lock medications away.

dem-kitchen-base0-DEM-K04.caption: The scene is a realistic depiction of an older American kitchen, characterized by a utilitarian aesthetic and a homely, lived-in tone. The kitchen features wood cabinets and a light-colored countertop that extends around the perimeter. A white refrigerator stands prominently at the left, while a black stove and dishwasher are integrated into the cabinetry. Open shelves filled with bowls are visible on the right, suggesting a practical and organized storage system. Several orange prescription pill bottles and pill containers are openly displayed on the counter to the left of the sink, indicating the daily routines of the occupants. A window above the sink allows natural light to enter, illuminating the space. The floor is covered with a patterned vinyl or linoleum, contributing to the kitchen's vintage charm. The design emphasizes functionality and comfort, typical of American homes from an earlier era. The overall layout suggests an efficient workspace for meal preparation and household activities. The 360 scene is faultless.

dem-entry-base0-DEM-E02.title: Back door left open to the outside
dem-entry-base0-DEM-E02.hazard: Glass back door standing open to the patio, an easy exit for wandering
dem-entry-base0-DEM-E02.text_prompt: Living room of an older adult with hardwood floors, two recliners, sofa, TV stand; at the back a glass-paned door stands wide open onto a sunny patio and garden outside.
dem-entry-base0-DEM-E02.hazard_name: Front door left open to the outside

guideline.line: Most people with dementia will wander; secure exterior doors (deadbolts out of eye line), disguise exits or add door alerts.

dem-entry-base0-DEM-E02.caption: The scene is a cozy living room, likely belonging to an older adult, rendered in a realistic style that evokes a sense of comfort and home. A sofa upholstered in a light fabric, adorned with patterned throw pillows, is located against a wall, facing a television set resting on a wooden TV stand. At the back of the room, a glass-paned door stands wide open, leading to a sunny patio and garden outside, which extends to the left and right, offering views of vibrant greenery and perhaps additional outdoor seating or garden features. The living room seamlessly transitions into other areas of the house, with subtle architectural details suggesting a well-maintained and cherished home environment. The 360 scene is faultless.

entry-base0-ENT-01.title: Entry steps without a handrail
entry-base0-ENT-01.hazard: Two concrete front steps with no handrail on either side
entry-base0-ENT-01.text_prompt: Front entry of a stone-and-siding house: a concrete walkway through shrubs and flower beds leads to two concrete steps up to a dark wooden front door with sidelights and a wall lantern; no handrail on either side of the steps.
entry-base0-ENT-01.caption: The scene is a realistic front entry of a stone-and-siding house, presented with a welcoming and well-maintained aesthetic. The overall tone is calm and inviting, suggesting a quiet residential setting. A concrete walkway stretches directly towards the front of the house, bordered on both sides by meticulously landscaped shrubs and flower beds. This pathway leads up to two sturdy concrete steps, providing access to the dark wooden front door. The front door is flanked by two clear sidelights, allowing light into the entryway, and a functional wall lantern illuminates the immediate area above the door, casting a warm glow on the stone facade. There are no handrails on either side of the steps, maintaining an open and uncluttered appearance. The house itself features a facade of variegated gray stone and a contrasting lighter siding material that wraps around the structure. On either side of the entryway, well-maintained green bushes and smaller plants are neatly arranged in garden beds. The concrete walkway extends into the foreground, inviting visitors towards the entrance. The 360 scene is faultless.

bedroom-base0-BED-01.caption: The scene is a realistic depiction of a simple bedroom, exuding a serene and functional tone suitable for an older adult. The entire room, including the areas beyond the current view, features a soft green carpet and white walls, maintaining a consistent and calm aesthetic. In the center of the room, a mattress, covered with a white and blue floral quilt, rests directly on the floor. To the right of the bed, a wooden nightstand stands, supporting a lamp with a white shade and a small, decorative tissue box. Adjacent to the nightstand, a dark wooden rocking chair with a green upholstered seat offers additional seating. On the left side of the room, a wooden dresser with multiple drawers provides storage. An open white door reveals a hallway stretching into the distance, with more doors visible along its length, suggesting other rooms are accessible from this central passage. A small nightlight glows near the floor in the hallway, illuminating the path. The walls of the bedroom are unadorned, contributing to the minimalist and uncluttered atmosphere. The 360 scene is faultless.
